title: Avalanche Liquid Staking - Open BENQI App
meta_description: avalanche liquid staking via BENQI: stake AVAX for sAVAX on Avalanche C-Chain, keep liquidity, and open the official app.
hero_h2: Stake AVAX into sAVAX while staying liquid
hero_lead: avalanche liquid staking is routed to BENQI, where AVAX holders can receive sAVAX on Avalanche C-Chain and keep a transferable staking position for DeFi use.
what_is: BENQI is the Avalanche DeFi protocol for staking AVAX into sAVAX, a transferable receipt token that represents a staked position. The BENQI docs describe staking from C-Chain and using sAVAX across DeFi.

how.d: Go to app.benqi.fi/savax and confirm the domain before connecting a wallet.
Use an Avalanche C-Chain wallet with AVAX available for staking and network gas.
Enter the AVAX amount, review the transaction, and receive sAVAX in the same wallet.
Use the unstake and claim flow when needed; BENQI documents a 15-day cooldown and 2-day redemption window.

points.p: sAVAX represents staked AVAX and accrues rewards through its exchange rate instead of requiring a locked wallet balance.
BENQI lets users stake from Avalanche C-Chain while the protocol handles the staking path behind the app.
Use the official app, review wallet prompts, and read the BENQI risk notes before depositing funds.

faq.a: It is staking AVAX through a liquid-staking protocol such as BENQI, where users receive sAVAX as a transferable representation of their staked position.

faq.q: How do I start avalanche liquid staking in the official app?
faq.a: Open app.benqi.fi/savax, connect an Avalanche C-Chain wallet, enter an AVAX amount, review the transaction, and stake.

faq.q: Does avalanche liquid staking lock my AVAX?
faq.a: sAVAX remains transferable, but using BENQI's unstake route has a documented cooldown before AVAX can be claimed.

faq.q: What token do I receive from avalanche liquid staking?
faq.a: BENQI issues sAVAX, which represents the staked AVAX position and accrued Avalanche staking rewards.

faq.q: What risks apply to avalanche liquid staking?
faq.a: Smart-contract risk, validator reward risk, liquidity conditions, and secondary-market pricing can all matter; review official docs and verify the app domain before signing.

footer_note: Not the official BENQI app; verify app.benqi.fi before connecting. Educational only, not financial advice.
